submitted.rationale: I measured five compositions. Index 7 (Sb 0.543) had the highest EQE at 0.0240%. Index 5 (Sb 0.467) was close behind at 0.0223%. EQE falls off in both directions from there: 0.0140% at Sb 0.65, 0.0022% at Sb 0.35 and 0.0004% at Sb 0.80. So the peak is in the mixed-phase range of about Sb 0.47–0.55, on the Cu-rich side of CuSb2O6.
